summary: Burst of failed RDP logons / lateral movement attempts sourced from single IP range (MITRE T1110). Often precedes ransomware deployment exploiting KEV CVE-2019-0708 / BlueKeep class flaws.

steps.action: Block offending IP range / geolocation at edge firewalls
Enforce MFA and conditional access on targeted accounts
steps.rationale: Prevents password reuse from brute-force success.

steps.action: Force password reset for accounts with repeated failures
steps.rationale: Mitigates credential stuffing with reused secrets.

steps.action: Collect Security Event IDs 4625/4624 and correlate host activity
Audit exposed RDP services for patch level and NLA status
